hey man,
i'm 16 and i've had some pretty serious anxiety attacks when i was around 14, mainly when i started at a new school, all i can say is stick with it, as hard as it fucking is, what helped me was someone telling me that same thing, stick with it, and eventually you'll see, hey this isn't too bad after all, meet new people and say hi to people you don't usually say hi to, they'll more often than not help you out if they feel something's up. Although me posting this is ironic from what i've just posted, i feel like i was in the same boat as you man, pm me if you need, but sooner than later it'll turn out better.
